Exceeding 50,000 MRU requires upgrading to Pro; exceeding 100 MRO requires upgrading to the B2B add-on
offers.notes: MRU definition: a user counts as retained when returning 24 hours after signing up. MRO definition: an organization has at least 2 members, with at least 1 being a retained user that month. Pro $20/month (annual billing), including 50,000 MRUs, $0.02 each beyond that; Business $250/month (annual billing).
